inlines.text: Anthropic 的 IPO 遇到麻烦：投资者对 1.5 万亿美元估值提出质疑，科技市场遭遇抛售。
据
路透社
报道，潜在投资方怀疑原定下周启动的路演能否如期进行。

blocks.text: 就在今年 9 月，该公司还瞄准最高 2 万亿美元的估值。如今一些投资者认为，即便 1.5 万亿美元也偏高。据报道，有一位投资者给出的估值仅为 1 万亿美元。投资者希望获得更大的折价，因为 Anthropic 仍在亏损，并持续烧钱扩张其 AI 基础设施。他们还在等待 10 月的营收数据，而更新后的 S-1 文件中并未包含这些数据。

blocks.text: 中期选举让局面雪上加霜。多个州通过了针对数据中心扩张的投票议案，引发了一年来最剧烈的科技股抛售。《华尔街日报》还报道称，IPO 投资者持怀疑态度。如果 AI 股票持续承压，Anthropic 可能会推迟上市，一些估算认为其规模最高可达 1000 亿美元。推迟上市可能进一步动摇外界对整个 AI 行业的信心。

blocks.text: Anthropic's IPO is in trouble as investors push back on the $1.5 trillion valuation and the tech market sells off. According to Reuters, potential backers doubt the planned roadshow can kick off next week as scheduled.

inlines.text: Anthropic's IPO is in trouble as investors push back on the $1.5 trillion valuation and the tech market sells off.
According to
Reuters
, potential backers doubt the planned roadshow can kick off next week as scheduled.

blocks.text: As recently as September, the company was eyeing a valuation of up to $2 trillion. Now some investors think even $1.5 trillion is too rich. One investor reportedly floated a valuation of just $1 trillion. Investors want a steeper discount because Anthropic is still losing money and burning through cash to scale its AI infrastructure. They're also waiting on October revenue numbers, which are missing from the updated S-1 filing.

blocks.text: The midterm elections made things worse. Ballot initiatives targeting data center expansion passed in several states, triggering the sharpest tech selloff in a year. The Wall Street Journal also reports that IPO investors are skeptical. If AI stocks stay under pressure, Anthropic could delay the offering, which some estimates peg at up to $100 billion in size. A delay could further shake confidence in the broader AI sector.
